verdict.rationale: Docs show scheduled automation for reports/status updates and event-based triggers (webhooks on create_item, change_column_value, agent mentions), which together support building recurring/scheduled workflows for routine work. However, evidence doesn't detail monday's core automation recipe builder, cron-style scheduling controls, or monitoring/error-handling for these workflows. Missing for 10: detailed schedule configuration UI/API, recipe builder specifics, failure/retry handling, and independent confirmation of reliability at scale.
